entries.scope: mods/Biology/info.json and official REDmod package root
entries.reason: Biology's first-party package identity lives under the official REDmod mods directory and has been recognized by the supported 2.31 tool.

entries.scope: tools/Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 game-root-shaped playable candidate and biology ownership/provenance metadata
entries.reason: The integrated release is REDmod-first: mods/Biology is the first-party identity and official REDmod deployment is proven, with individually justified supplemental files where whole-file replacement would be less robust.

entries.scope: future Biology-owned archive/resource payload
entries.reason: REDmod natively stages archives from a mod package. No first-party archive payload is required by the current candidate.

entries.scope: Biology-owned REDmod tweak source including launcher activation marker
entries.reason: REDmod natively compiles Biology tweak source and owns the launcher activation marker.

entries.scope: future Biology-owned customSounds payload
entries.reason: REDmod has a native customSounds route; Biology currently has no custom audio payload.

entries.scope: future first-party cooked animation/UI/resource archives
entries.reason: Cooked first-party resources belong under Biology's REDmod identity when they actually exist; runtime controller behavior remains separately classified.

entries.scope: src/redscript/CyberpunkRealism/*.reds project-owned models/runtime classes without whole-file vanilla replacement
entries.reason: Biology's runtime is additive project-owned REDscript and uses narrow wrapper seams. Forcing it into vanilla-path REDmod .script replacement would broaden replacement ownership.

entries.scope: hook files enumerated in manifest/native-seams.json using @wrapMethod/@replaceMethod/@addMethod/@addField
entries.reason: These seams intercept small game-facing methods. Whole-file replacement would copy/own substantially more vanilla implementation for the same behavior. Exact compilation against 2.31 remains a mandatory build gate.

entries.scope: copying vanilla .script files solely to replace current wrapper/additive hooks
entries.reason: Official REDmod supports modified vanilla-path scripts, but conflict is at file granularity and game patches can invalidate copied implementation unrelated to Biology's narrow hook.

entries.scope: Biology-owned Ink/REDscript controller/runtime behavior for body shell, HUD and nameplates
entries.reason: Current body/menu and presentation work uses Biology-owned additive/wrapper REDscript with native game authority. Whole vanilla-file replacement would broaden the compatibility seam.

entries.scope: CRRealpassSettings persistent E3 Boolean plus Biology-owned body-shell Ink editor
entries.reason: The remaining preference is one save-backed Biology Boolean. Reusing the existing Biology-owned body shell avoids invasive native settings-screen ownership and removes the external provider stack while keeping the seam narrow.

entries.scope: former need for player-accessible persistence/UI for the small Biology-owned preference surface
entries.reason: Resolved by issue #61 source architecture: whole-mod activation moved solely to REDlauncher/REDmod and the remaining E3 preference is Biology-owned save state edited from Biology's body shell. Parent attended persistence/UI acceptance remains required.

entries.scope: redscript 0.5.31 runtime/compiler plumbing
entries.reason: Directly consumed by Biology-owned additive/wrapper runtime/native seams, ScriptableSystem preference persistence, and Biology-owned Ink UI.

entries.scope: Mod Settings 0.2.21
entries.reason: Removed from production by issue #61. No Biology production consumer remains; Biology owns preference persistence/UI directly.

entries.scope: ArchiveXL 1.27.3
entries.reason: Removed from production by issue #61. Its only Biology role was transitive support for Mod Settings and no direct consumer remains.

entries.scope: RED4ext 1.30.0
entries.reason: Removed from production by issue #61. Biology owns no RED4ext plugin and the retired settings stack was its only current route.

entries.scope: TweakXL 1.11.4
entries.reason: No current Biology consumer; excluded from the integrated candidate.

entries.scope: Codeware 1.20.3
entries.reason: No current Biology consumer; excluded from the integrated candidate.

entries.scope: Input Loader 0.2.3
entries.reason: No current Biology custom input-binding consumer; excluded from the integrated candidate.

entries.scope: Dark Future executing payload
entries.reason: Research/provenance only; forbidden from Biology runtime.

entries.scope: Project E3 executing payload
entries.reason: Local-only design/provenance reference; Project E3 runtime content is forbidden from Biology artifacts.

entries.scope: manifest/package.json and tools/Build-Package.ps1 as final player architecture
entries.reason: Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 is the canonical integrated player-candidate route. Legacy development builders must remain clearly labeled and may be retired when no current test/recovery consumer requires them.

entries.scope: archive/pc/mod as a default Biology first-party deployment route
entries.reason: No project-original archive source currently requires the legacy root. New first-party archive content should use mods/Biology/archives.

entries.scope: installed tools/redmod/bin/redMod.exe path/version/help contract
entries.reason: Direct probe confirmed the installed official REDmod tool, deploy module and root option. Biology's helper owns safe argument construction and fail-closed output validation.

entries.scope: actual recognition/deployment of the integrated mods/Biology candidate
entries.reason: Attended preflight on Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 observed Biology discovery, all five deploy stages, mods.json output and successful completion using the repaired explicit-root helper.

entries.scope: actual precedence when enabled REDmods overlap the same safe fixture file
entries.reason: Official documentation describes order semantics, but the safe overlap/precedence fixture has not yet been accepted directly.

entries.scope: future Biology-owned or generic DLL/native hook
entries.reason: Reserved for a concrete feature that cannot be implemented safely through vanilla semantics, REDmod, or retained redscript. No current Biology feature proves such a requirement.
